name: Daniel Sánchez Arévalo
bio: Daniel Sánchez Arévalo is a Spanish film and television writer, director and producer.

credits.overview: In the middle of the night, José Luis, an Extremadura pig herder comes home covered in blood, insisting he has seen a tiger. Is he telling the truth – or improvising an outlandish alibi to hide that he was stealing three Iberian pigs?

credits.overview: Spain, 2013. After robbing a bank, a getaway crash reveals the hidden side of each thief, exposing betrayals and lies that began long before the heist.
